name: Scroll of Mage Hand
description: A strip of vellum, one line of cramped script and a smell of cold hearths. Read it aloud and the hand is borrowed, once.
notes: A scroll of Mage Hand (mw-ju8.4), spell.mage-hand. Book kind scroll (mw-e07.1): reading it casts the spell once, free, for any class, and spends the scroll (owner decision 2026-10-24). That runtime is mw-ju8.17; `book.casts` is added with it, once spell content exists (mw-e08), because a spell reference to a missing spell fails the load. Base value 50 sits in the economy scroll band (40-150).
